difficulty_rationale: Multi-module promotion-workflow feature: new promotion_reviews table (6-state CHECK constraint + partial unique index), SHA-256 plan digest binding, conflict pre-flight detection, review state machine, and non-skippable approval gate spanning API routes + event-store emission + a new DB migration.
integration_surface_rationale: Touches src/api/routes/promotions.zig (PRM-01 surface), event-store emission (DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED / _APPLIED), and a new promotion_reviews table; promotion pipeline callers must adopt the new digest/gate flow. No engine/scheduler/auth-middleware changes.
